assign.outcome:
**Mag remembers what you've read; the game gained a voice of your own and a keyboard.**

![Two articles read, a quiet mark on each, and Reset](shots/mag-read-state.png)

- [**Mag — read state**](/imagine/mag/contents/): an article marks itself read on visit (`Article.activated()`), the contents page shows a quiet `--subtle` checkmark per entry and an "N of 6 read" line, and *Reset* clears it — all through one `page.store()` key on the contents page. Reactive (`watch()`/`bump()`), because the contents column never re-renders once mounted.
- [**Game — add your own goal**](/imagine/game/journal/): one input on the Journal page, landing in the journal's own row markup as a separate `goals[]` array (never merged with the game's own past-tense log), persisted via `page.store()` — the third field added to the saved shape, same pattern as `sights`/`log`.
- [**Game — keyboard travel**](/imagine/game/verge/gate/): digits 1-9 click the Nth `.imagine-exit` (a CSS counter draws the number), one listener on the root page scoped to `.page.active-page`, with a focused-input guard checked first — typing into the new goal input never navigates.

**Verified headless**: 2 articles visited → "2 of 6 read" + 2 marks → survives reload → Reset → "0 of 6 read" → survives reload. Add-a-goal appears, persists across reload, Enter and the button both submit. Pressing `1` at a room navigates to its first exit; the same digit typed into the focused goal input does not, then navigates once blurred. Zero console errors, no overflow, 400/1920/3440 on every changed page.

**Docs**: one line each in [mag/readme.md](/imagine/mag/readme/) and [game/readme.md](/imagine/game/readme/), full records in [mag/doc/decisions.md](/imagine/mag/doc/decisions.md) and [game/doc/decisions.md](/imagine/game/doc/decisions.md). Fixed two stale `game/readme.md` lines still describing the retired `store.js` prototype.

**Cut**: nothing — both S items shipped in full, no roadmap left within this fence.
